title: Conflicting empty-time requirements
description: EVT-01.c says an omitted time blocks saving; EVT-02.h says an empty time means 0:00.
resolution: Product Owner decision: an empty start uses now and an empty end uses the configured default event length.

title: An agent used git stash on the shared tree during Sprint 013
description: Ito ran git stash and pop while other agents were editing; for about a minute their files were at HEAD. The Kobayashi audit checked every handoff behavior and found no lost edit. Rule: an agent never restores a file from git while another agent owns it (sprint-planning, File ownership).
resolution: No edit lost (Kobayashi audit); brief for the next sprint says: no git stash or checkout
